items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: So, I got him lined up in the, in the radio station.

ctx.x: Well, he, Johnny is a very fine school musician, see? Mm-hmm. And, well, he had an experience. He came out here, too. So, I got him lined up in the, in the radio station. And, it was just around Thanksgiving time. And, we had, we were all playing for a nice great big dinner. For Johnny, see? Yeah. And, uh, Johnny's all set to open up at this big radio station. And, I three-sheeted him all over the town. What a fine trumpet player was. And, he is. And, uh, there comes the, the Thanksgiving dinner, little Johnny.…
That's quick, huh? Some of these guys get lonesome. Couldn't, couldn't take it. They're homesick and they can't take it.
